system.flavor:
Put yourself between a friend and a falling beam, take a horse's kick meant for a child, shrug off a thrown stone, or catch a collapsing shelf on your back.

Not enough to stop a crossbow bolt or live through a roof coming down.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1. You may end your Adaptation to reduce it by 1 more.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by the Action until the start of your next turn.
Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties on yourself until the start of your next turn.
